Q: Minor Upgrade of Apache Tomcat || from 9.0.56 to 9.0.105 on linux A:
  1. Compare apache-tomcat-9.0.115 with your currently installed Tomcat. What are the differences between the directory structures (for the bin and lib directories)?

CURRENT - OLD

# /usr/share/tomcat/lib/ - 9.0.87
annotations-api.jar
catalina-ant.jar
catalina-ha.jar
catalina.jar
...
* tomcat-el-api.jar
* tomcat-jsp-api.jar
* tomcat-servlet-api.jar
* tomcat-juli.jar
* jasper-jdt.jar (-> /usr/share/java/ecj/ecj.jar)
* tomcat-el-3.0-api.jar
* tomcat-jsp-2.3-api.jar
* tomcat-servlet-4.0-api.jar

9.0.115 - NEW

# /tmp/apache-tomcat-9.0.115/lib
annotations-api.jar
catalina-ant.jar
catalina-ha.jar
catalina.jar
...
* el-api.jar
* jsp-api.jar
* servlet-api.jar
* tomcat-coyote-ffm.jar
* ecj-4.20.jar

DEL OLD JAR

sudo rm /usr/share/tomcat/lib/tomcat-el-3.0-api.jar
sudo rm /usr/share/tomcat/lib/tomcat-jsp-2.3-api.jar
sudo rm /usr/share/tomcat/lib/tomcat-servlet-4.0-api.jar
sudo rm /usr/share/tomcat/lib/tomcat-el-api.jar
sudo rm /usr/share/tomcat/lib/tomcat-jsp-api.jar
sudo rm /usr/share/tomcat/lib/tomcat-servlet-api.jar
sudo rm /usr/share/tomcat/lib/jasper-jdt.jar

COPY LIB

cd /tmp/apache-tomcat-9.0.115/lib
sudo cp *.jar /usr/share/tomcat/lib/

Q: GTK+3 combobox on touchscreen workaround A:

I came across the same issue all over linux mint OS with touch screen and found out its dependent on GtkScrolledWindow scroll state — when content fits without scrolling (scrollbar hidden), all combobox popups dismiss on touch. When the window is resized small enough to require scrolling, they work correctly.

documented it in detail on my git https://github.com/julianjc84/gtk3-combobox-touch-bug
